violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW CHICKEN STORED ABOVE BEANS AND VEGETABLES IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REORGANIZED FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: YOGURT SAUCE AND DUMPLING MIXES IN HOSHIZAKI 2 DOOR UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR; RICE, NOODLES AND FRIED PEPPERS IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR ALL PREPARED FOR MORE THAN 24 HOURS.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC APPLIED LABELS WITH APPROPRIATE DATE MARKING DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Corrosion-Resistant/Nonabsorbent Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not durable: TAKE OUT/GROCERY BAGS USED TO STORE PREPARED DUMPLINGS IN FREEZER.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be durable, corrosion-resistant, and nonabsorbent. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE REMOVE FOODS FROM TAKE OUT/GROCERY BAGS AND PROVIDE NSF APPROVED, FOOD SAFE CONTAINERS OR BAGS FOR FOOD STORAGE.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the WALLS AND FLOORS in the KITCHEN ARE in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE PROVIDE THOROUGH CLEANING AND IMPLEMENT AN APPROPRIATE CLEANING SCHEDULE.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM ON SITE TIME OIF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM MUST BE ON SITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION INCLUDING DURING PREPARATION. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cleaning Procedure
violations.observation: Observed food employees using improper handwashing procedures. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE WASHED HANDS WITHOUT APPLYING HAND SOAP.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wash their hands and exposed portions of their arms by: 1) discarding used gloves; 2) rinsing under warm running water; 3) applying soap; 4) rubbing together for at least 10-15 seconds; 5) rinsing thoroughly under warm running water; and 6) drying with paper towels or air drying device. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO WASH HANDS WITH SOAP USING PROPER HANDWASHING PROCEDURES DURING THE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: CABBAGE MIX AT 59F ON CART NEAR COOK LINE; COMMERCIAL SAMOSAS AT 62F ON FREEZER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD FOODS DURING INSPECTION.

violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: VARIOUS FOODS PREPARED FOR MORE THAN 24 HOURS WITHOUT DATE MARKING: RICE, NOODLES , CHICK PEAS, FRIED VEGETABLES IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR; TOMATO CHUTNEY, YOGURT SAUCES IN HOSHIZAKI 2 DOOR UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE FOODS PREPARED AND HELD FOR MORE THAN 24 HOURS ARE DATE MARKED. COMPLIANCE WILL BEE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION. violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: WORKING CONTAINERS AND SQUEEZE BOTTLES OF SPICES, SALT, SUGAR, OILS AND SAUCES.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE ALL WORKING CONTAINERS OF FOODS REMOVED FROM ORIGINAL PACKAGING ARE LABELED. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION. Momo Spot (Inspection Date: 12/18/2025) Page 3 of 4

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE ALL FOODS ARE ELEVATED AT LEAST 6 INCHES OFF THE FLOOR. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: UTENSILS STORED IN WATER AT 81F ON STOVE TOP; STYROFOAM CUPS AND CONDIMENT CONTAINERS USED TO DISPENSE PREPARED SAUCES IN HOSHIZAKI 2 DOOR UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REPLACE UTENSILS AND MAINTAIN IN WATER AT 135F OR ABOVE; TO REMOVE CONTAINERS AND USE SCOOPS WITH HANDLES.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items Storage and Handling
violations.observation: SINGLE SERVICE CONTAINERS were found handled, displayed or dispensed with the food or lip-contact surface facing upward.
violations.corrective_action: Single-service items and cleaned/sanitized utensils shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed so that contamination of food and lip contact surfaces are prevented. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO INVERT SINGLE SERVICE CONTAINERS ONCE REMOVED FROM PACKAGING.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: ALUMINUM FOIL OBSERVED LINING COOK LINE AND CART NEAR COOK LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REMOVE FOIL DURING INSPECTION. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: Milk crate(s) found used for the following purpose(s): STORE FOODS, UTENSILS AND SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS.
violations.corrective_action: Milk crates, soda crates, and/or bread racks are not designed to store or elevate food, equipment, utensils, clean linens, and single-service items. Provide only ANSI-certified (such as NSF-listed) shelving units, storage units, or dunnage racks. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE REMOVE FOODS AND OTHER ITEMSS FROM CRATES AND USE ONLY APPROVED STORAGE CONTAINERS OR UNITS. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Corrosion-Resistant/Nonabsorbent Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not durable: GROCERY BAGS USED TO STORE DUMPLINGS AND OTHER FOODS IN FREEZERS.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be durable, corrosion-resistant, and nonabsorbent. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE REMOVE FOODS FROM GROCERY BAGS AND USE ONLY FOOD SAFE BAGS FOR FOOD STORAGE. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: COOK LINE; SURFACES AND INSIDE OF REFRIGERATION UNITS; SHELVING UNITS AND STORAGE UNITS.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE CLEAN AND IMPLEMENT AN APPROPRIATE CLEANING SCHEDULE. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Where to Wash

violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO WASH HANDS AT HANDWASH SINK ONLY.

violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO SET UP SANITIZING BASIN OF 3 COMPARTMENT SINK WITH SANITIZING SOLUTION OF APPROPRIATE CONCENTRATION TO SANITIZE DISHES. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Cold Holding
